payload.text: She ___ to school every day.
payload.explanation_uz: Present Simple'da he/she/it bilan fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi: go -> goes.

payload.text: Yesterday I ___ a good film. (watch)
payload.explanation_uz: Past Simple'da muntazam fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: watch -> watched.

payload.text: They ___ to Samarkand last summer. (go)
payload.explanation_uz: Go noto'g'ri fe'l: Past Simple shakli went.

payload.text: Look! The children ___ in the garden. (play)
payload.explanation_uz: Hozir davom etayotgan harakat Present Continuous bilan ifodalanadi: am/is/are + fe'l-ing.

payload.text: My brother is ___ than me. (tall)
payload.explanation_uz: Qisqa sifatlarda qiyosiy daraja -er qo'shimchasi bilan yasaladi: tall -> taller.

payload.text: This is the ___ book I have ever read. (good)
payload.explanation_uz: Good sifatining orttirma darajasi noto'g'ri shaklda: good - better - the best.

payload.text: I am ___ to visit my grandmother tomorrow.
payload.explanation_uz: Oldindan rejalashtirilgan ish am/is/are going to + fe'l bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: Wait, I ___ help you with that heavy bag.
payload.explanation_uz: Gap paytida qabul qilingan qaror yoki taklif will + fe'l bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
payload.explanation_uz: Inkor gaplarda sanalmaydigan otlar bilan any ishlatiladi.

payload.text: How ___ people are there in the room?
payload.explanation_uz: Sanaladigan ko'plik otlar bilan how many ishlatiladi.

payload.text: How ___ water do you drink every day?
payload.explanation_uz: Sanalmaydigan otlar (water) bilan how much ishlatiladi.

payload.text: You ___ wear a seatbelt in the car. It is the law.
payload.explanation_uz: Qonun yoki qat'iy majburiyatni must yoki have to bilan ifodalaymiz.

payload.text: I ___ swim when I was five years old.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi qobiliyat can ning o'tgan zamon shakli could bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: Anna is ill. She ___ see a doctor.
payload.explanation_uz: Maslahat berish uchun should + fe'l ishlatiladi.

payload.text: My birthday is ___ May.
payload.explanation_uz: Oylar, yillar va fasllar oldidan in predlogi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: The meeting is ___ Monday.
payload.explanation_uz: Hafta kunlari va sanalar oldidan on predlogi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: The class starts ___ nine o'clock.
payload.explanation_uz: Aniq soat oldidan at predlogi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: He ___ late for work. (always)
payload.explanation_uz: Takrorlanish ravishlari to be fe'lidan keyin, boshqa fe'llardan oldin keladi: is always.

payload.text: This is Anna's bag. The bag is ___.
payload.explanation_uz: Egalik olmoshining mustaqil shakli: she -> hers (keyin ot kelmaydi).

payload.text: My parents have a new car. ___ car is red.
payload.explanation_uz: Ot oldidan egalik sifatlari ishlatiladi: they -> their.

payload.text: I like tea, ___ I don't like coffee.
payload.explanation_uz: Qarama-qarshilikni bildirish uchun but bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
payload.explanation_uz: Natijani bildirish uchun so bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: We stayed at home ___ it was raining.
payload.explanation_uz: Sababni bildirish uchun because bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I ___ TV when you called me. (watch)
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishda boshqa voqea paytida davom etayotgan harakat Past Continuous bilan ifodalanadi: was/were + fe'l-ing.

payload.text: She ___ fish. (not like)
payload.explanation_uz: Present Simple inkorida he/she/it bilan doesn't + fe'l ishlatiladi.

payload.question: Which sentence is correct?
payload.explanation_uz: Doesn't dan keyin fe'l asosiy shaklda keladi, -s qo'shilmaydi.

payload.question: She ___ her keys yesterday.
payload.explanation_uz: Lose noto'g'ri fe'l: Past Simple shakli lost.

payload.question: What is the comparative form of "good"?
payload.explanation_uz: Good sifati noto'g'ri shakllanadi: good - better - best.

payload.question: Tom is ___ student in our class.
payload.explanation_uz: Uzun sifatlarning orttirma darajasi the most + sifat bilan yasaladi.

payload.question: Which noun is uncountable?
payload.explanation_uz: Water sanalmaydigan ot, uni a/an bilan ishlatib bo'lmaydi va ko'plik shakli yo'q.

payload.question: Right now, Sara ___ a letter.
payload.explanation_uz: Right now bilan hozir davom etayotgan harakat Present Continuous (is writing) da bo'ladi.

payload.question: You ___ park here. It is forbidden.
payload.explanation_uz: Mustn't taqiqni bildiradi, don't have to esa majburiy emasligini bildiradi.

payload.question: Tomorrow is Sunday. We ___ get up early.
payload.explanation_uz: Don't have to biror ishni qilish shart emasligini bildiradi.

payload.question: Which sentence has the correct word order?
payload.explanation_uz: Takrorlanish ravishi to be fe'lidan keyin keladi: I am always happy.

payload.question: The two girls share a room. It is the ___ room.
payload.explanation_uz: -s bilan tugagan ko'plik otlarda egalik faqat apostrof bilan yasaladi: girls'.

payload.question: There are ___ apples on the table.
payload.explanation_uz: Darak gaplarda ko'plik otlar bilan some ishlatiladi.

payload.question: Is there ___ sugar in your tea?
payload.explanation_uz: Savol gaplarda sanalmaydigan otlar bilan any ishlatiladi.

payload.question: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgi belgilarga asoslangan bashorat am/is/are going to bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.question: The shop is ___ the bank and the post office.
payload.explanation_uz: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi joy between predlogi bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.question: Where ___ you yesterday evening?
payload.explanation_uz: You bilan to be ning o'tgan zamon shakli were ishlatiladi.
